type: method-development (OPE structure constant, attempt v3: parity-fixed PEV)
hardware: local CPU (single-thread BLAS, deterministic basins; chi=6 x 8 seeds x 2500 LBFGS, wall 4390 s)
goal: Pass the OPE validation gate (C_sse -> 0.5 +-10% AND Z2-forbidden C_sss < 0.02 across >=3 clean basins at chi=6) after fixing the root cause identified 2026-07-02: operator parity contamination, NOT rho3 geometry.
what_was_built: qw_ope_pev.jl (v3). Pre-build finding that reframed the problem: re-reading PEV (0810.0580) + index-level audit of v2 against MERAKit's descend conventions PROVED v2's rho3 geometry correct (PEV Eq. 13 IS the consecutive-3-site trace; Fig 2(iii) registration = build_rho3_cone; 2^Omega = v2's r13=2 kinematics). Two stacked parity bugs found instead: (1) v1/v2 lifted X(x)X, but DemoTools Ising is H=-XX+Z-field whose Z2 is Z^{(x)N} -- a NON-symmetry was lifted; (2) v1's coarse_parity partial-traced the traceless parity (annihilation -> noise -> re-converged to identity). v3: correct Z-parity; layer-by-layer covariance lift (rank-1 SVD of u'(P(x)P)u, identity-lift selftest passes at 1e-16); parity projection of sigma/eps; PEV Eq. 10 normalization under fixedpoint_densitymatrix; BOTH width-3 registrations (cone + mirror) as translation-invariance error bar; C_ssI/C_seI free consistency probes.
verdict: GATE FAIL (honest negative) -- but with a DECISIVE new discriminant: the one-site parity LIFT ITSELF fails on every dense basin (SVD dominance 1.2-1.8 where covariance predicts >>1; overlap 0.05-0.26; SI iteration non-convergent si_d~1.4). Projecting with the resulting noise-involution MANGLED sigma on most basins (C_sse up to 54).

results_clean_basins.consistency_probes: C_ssI = 0.997-1.036 across ALL seeds (rho3-marginal plumbing consistent); TI(rho3A vs rho3B) = 0.004-0.028 (registrations agree); <sig>=<eps>=0 (no magnetized basins)

why_failed: The lift's structural assumption -- that the Z2 symmetry acts as a PRODUCT of one-site P's on the internal legs -- is false for dense LBFGS MERAs: random-init dense optimization lands in a GENERIC GAUGE where the pushed-through symmetry is a finite-depth circuit on internal legs, not on-site. The rank-1 factorization of u'(P(x)P)u therefore has no dominant product component (dominance ~1), P comes out as noise, and (sigma - P sigma P)/2 injects even junk instead of removing it. Seeds 1/8 (least-contaminated basins) still give C_sse~0.46-0.56, C_sss~0.05-0.06 -- better than v2's spread but above gate; the projection made the best v2 basin (seed1: 0.008) slightly WORSE. PEV's original algorithm avoided this: environment-SVD updates from symmetric-ish starting points PRESERVE covariance, so their dense tensors were de facto covariant; Riemannian LBFGS from random dense init is not.
next_route: Z2-SYMMETRIC TENSORS (Z2Space) -- make parity exact by construction: sigma = lowest ODD-sector scaling operator, cross-sector contamination structurally impossible, C_sss identically zero (the design-doc's structural argument, delivered by symmetric tensors instead of charged-op gymnastics). MERAKit + demo support this (demo.jl IS Z2 ternary Ising, the documented working invocation). v1's LAPACKException(23) warning plausibly refers to the expand_bonddim RAMP path; direct-init at target chi being tested (qw_ope_z2smoke.jl). Gate then shifts to C_sse -> 0.5 stable across clean basins + C_eee -> 0 (still a live dynamical zero-probe). Fallback if Z2 tensors fail on-platform: covariant-initialized dense LBFGS (Reynolds-symmetrized random init; gradient flow preserves covariance up to fp drift).
runpod_decision: STILL NOT WARRANTED. chi remains a non-blocker; the extraction basis is. Same 'GPU on a broken contraction is wasted money' case as SIM-058.
what_we_learned: (1) Fetch the primary source BEFORE redesigning -- the PEV paper was on disk all along and settled in one read what two failed rebuilds guessed at. (2) A parity check returning +1 for everything is a broken operator, not a weak signal. (3) Dense-gauge MERAs hide on-site symmetries in circuits; any per-site symmetry machinery needs symmetric tensors or covariant initialization. (4) The v3 diagnostics stack (selftest, dominance/overlap, C_ssI, TI error, one-points) localized the failure in ONE run -- keep it in v4.
status: COMPLETE (negative result; v4 = Z2-symmetric-tensor route in progress)
